implementation: Independent prior-range, prior-mean-true-range, path-efficiency, relative-volume and close-location hypotheses; not a replica of the cited scripts
baseline: Existing Donchian or Squeeze research simulator; not the live account strategy
storage: Immutable PostgreSQL range-volume-study-v1 business state; ClickHouse read-only market input; no local business state
validation: Fixed-parameter chronological development/holdout split, same-cost ablation, double-fee-and-slippage holdout; not parameter search or walk-forward certification
cost_stress_interpretation: Cost stress recomputes position sizing and venue-size eligibility; a smaller net loss can reflect fewer fills, not improved robustness. Inspect entry_rejections and trade counts alongside PnL.
release_gate: No automatic selection or live admission. Require complete market data, funding and contract-rule validation, representative out-of-sample samples and operational latency acceptance before any later activation.
